title: Foundations + estimation
focus: How requests flow, how systems grow, and how to size them with back-of-envelope numbers.
deliverable: Write a one-page capacity estimate (QPS, storage, bandwidth) for a photo-sharing app, and explain which number drives the design.

title: Networking
focus: DNS, TCP/UDP, HTTP, TLS and the boxes in front of your servers.
deliverable: Draw the full path of one HTTPS request from browser to database, labelling every hop and its latency budget.

title: APIs + rate limiting
focus: REST, GraphQL, gRPC, gateways, rate limiting and safe retries.
deliverable: Design a public REST API for a todo service with pagination, idempotent creates and a documented rate-limit policy.

title: DB I: modeling, indexing, transactions
focus: Pick a data store by access pattern, model the data, index it and keep it correct under concurrency.
deliverable: Model the schema for a ticket-booking system, list its indexes, and show how you prevent double booking.

title: DB II: replication, sharding, consistent hashing
focus: Copy data for availability, split it for scale, and move as little as possible when nodes change.
deliverable: Choose a shard key for a chat app's messages table and defend it against hot partitions.

title: Storage & search
focus: Blobs, inverted indexes, and analytics stores.
deliverable: Sketch the upload path for user videos with presigned URLs and multipart upload.

title: Caching
focus: Every cache layer, every write strategy, and the ways caches fail.
deliverable: Add a cache to the news-feed read path and write down how each failure mode (stampede, stale reads, hot key) is handled.

title: Messaging
focus: Queues, pub/sub, delivery guarantees and event-driven design.
deliverable: Design the notification pipeline with retries, a dead-letter queue and per-user ordering.

title: Distributed systems
focus: CAP, consistency, quorums, consensus, clocks, transactions, IDs and locks.
deliverable: Explain, with a timeline diagram, how a distributed lock without fencing tokens corrupts data.

title: Reliability
focus: Stay up when parts fail: redundancy, timeouts, breakers, shedding and recovery.
deliverable: Write the failure plan for a checkout service: timeouts, retry budget, breaker thresholds, RPO and RTO.

title: Observability + security
focus: See what the system does and keep the wrong people out.
deliverable: Define three SLIs and SLOs for an API and the burn-rate alert for each.

title: Deployment + capstone build
focus: Ship safely: containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD, release strategies, infrastructure as code.
deliverable: Build your capstone design in Design Studio and write its rollout plan (canary steps and rollback trigger).

title: Advanced + AI-native
focus: Serverless, edge, streams, multi-region, and systems built around LLMs.
deliverable: Design a RAG docs assistant with a latency and cost budget per request.

title: Interview framework + case studies 1–7
focus: Learn the 7-step framework and apply it to the first seven case studies.
deliverable: Solve two case studies end to end in Interview Mode (practice) and self-score them with the rubric.

title: Case studies 8–15 + mock interviews
focus: The harder case studies, deep-dive patterns, and timed mocks.
deliverable: Run three timed mock interviews and log the weakest framework step in each.

title: Weak spots + mock interviews
focus: Close the gaps the app has measured, then rehearse under time pressure.
deliverable: Clear every weak spot on /today and finish two more timed mocks with self-scores of 3+ on every rubric row.
